title: LoL Esports |
content:
We are approaching the conclusion of the League of Legends Championship Pacific (LCP) Swiss Stage, where the competition continues to heat up as teams fight for a spot at the Playoffs. From there, only three teams will earn the right to compete at Finals Weekend Taipei, where the LCP 2026 champion will be crowned!

With the race to Finals Weekend well underway, we wanted to give fans a sneak peek at what they can look forward to at theTaipei Heping Basketball Gymnasiumfrom 29 to 30 August.

In partnership with VNGGames, Carry International, PlayBrain, Arcanist, and Invate, and proudly supported by Chunghwa Telecom, ROG, and SIDIZ, LCP Finals Weekend Taipei brings together the game, esport, and community for a weekend packed with exciting activities and exclusive merchandise for an unforgettable experience.

We will be showcasing original artwork by our talented community at the LCP Artist Alley! Stop by to support their work and take home a piece of memorabilia.

Finals Weekend Taipei and Riot Games Merchandise

Get your hands on limited edition merchandise, including the exclusive LCP Finals Weekend Taipei t-shirt and mousepad! Official Riot Games merchandise will also be on sale, so don’t miss your chance to pick up some of our best selling plushies and collectible figurines.

title: League of Legends Tier List: Best Champions for Every Role (2026)
summary: League of Legends Tier List: Best Champions for Every Role (2026)  Esports.gg
content:
XC is a long-time player and enjoyer of anything video games, with some tech on the side. He has spent countless hours on MOBAs, single-player RPGs, and competitive shooters. XC's also a massive esports fan.

Mage bot is still rampant in Patch 26.15.

Want to pick the absolute best champions for your next climb to Challenger (or out of Gold)? This esports.gg League of Legends tier list ranks the strongest champion across every role based on factors like current patch performance and statistics, solo queue effectiveness, game impact, and more. This tier list was last updated onAug. 10, 2026,forLoL Patch 26.15.

Good top lane picks for Patch 26.15 generally have to either be AD, Bruiser, or an Engage Tank/frontline. This is partly because of the mage botlane meta being dominant – the magic damage in the bottom side of the draft needs to be counterbalanced somehow.

Some champions, like Fiora, Dr. Mundo, Gangplank, and Kayle, get considerably stronger with a roaming support on the team.

Like top lane, Junglers are also affected by the mage bot meta. AD damage-dealing junglers like Graves and Briar dominate games and allow for a more balanced damage type spread across the team. Meanwhile, playmaking junglers like Jarvan IV and Wukong remain good thanks to being an easy path to get the carries ahead.
